About Me

A little about myself and what drives me

Creative Technologist

Hi, I’m Mike—a Creative Technologist with 9+ years of experience in higher education and academic libraries. I help turn complex ideas into clear, usable digital experiences that support learning, research, and access to knowledge.

My path began in classrooms and libraries, teaching college-level English and working closely with students and faculty. Those experiences shaped how I think about communication, learning, and user experience—and showed me that the work I find most meaningful is designing tools that make information approachable and intuitive.

I combine a humanities-centered background with skills in web development, digital humanities, media production, and emerging technologies. I hold an ALA-accredited Master of Information and an MA in English, and I’m currently completing TripleTen’s AI Automation bootcamp to deepen my experience with AI-assisted instructional tools and scalable learning workflows.

Today, I focus on integrating human-centered technology—including AI—into educational and library environments to improve clarity, accessibility, and engagement.
